runtime: Whisper.net 1.9.1 CPU; AVX, AVX2, F16C, FMA, OpenMP and repack enabled; no CoreML or OpenVINO

method.audio: Three French Windows TTS phrases generated once and retained in memory as 16 kHz mono float samples
method.metrics: Case-insensitive punctuation-free token Levenshtein WER, median inference seconds, and median real-time factor
method.limitations: Synthetic TTS is suitable for relative comparison only. Number formatting is counted as word errors. Real microphone quality requires a user recheck.

selection.qualityGate: PASS: 15 normalized errors versus 17 for Q5_0
selection.latencyGate: PASS: 3.457 seconds versus the best Q5_0 median of 4.047 seconds

productVerificationAfterPreparation.recognizedText: Bonjour, ceci est un test de transcription local rapide et précise.

decision: Select Base Q8_0 with eight threads. Prepare and warm the persistent processor while recording so its 2.408-second setup cost is normally hidden before Stop. Keep a real-voice recheck mandatory because the synthetic phrase still contains one agreement error.
